title: 第19章 玄极天界圣星第20章 魔武塔
slug: 圣殇天狱第1013章力战古神
content_zh:
在界河一角，
有一个星空超级巨大黑洞，
里面热气腾腾，火焰熊熊，火光冲天。
一般的神到这里都会被太玄天阳火焚毁，
渣都不会剩，
每天的太阳都会西沉到这个巨大黑洞，
然后另外的太阳又从另一边升起，
这里有很多颗太阳，
在天体运行的是成熟的太阳，
因为宇宙不知道存在了多少年，
所以有不少失去了能量的太阳成为废星，飘荡在这个巨大黑洞缓慢旋转，
这些庞大的废星上，有的生存有生灵，
他们便是玄极天族；太阳神族！
身体强悍，法力强大。
他们会挑选最强大的圣子圣女，
到达一定法力后，便操控驾驭这些太阳，光耀各界。
···
在巨大的黑洞旁边，
还有一个超级黑洞，
里面阴冷无边，到处是霜，冷极风呼呼呼的吹，冷光无边，

神级以下到这里都会被太玄阴极光，冰冻裂成渣粉，
冷极风一吹，粉都不会剩。
里面有很多月亮，
每天太阳西下时，成熟的月亮便会飘然升空，
接替太阳为各界带去月辉，以及玄阴之气，
净化万界地阴煞气，
那些不能再光耀万界的废弃月亮上，
同样有生灵生存，月亮神族，
她们同样极度强大，
成熟月亮也是由强大的圣子圣女操控驾驭，光照各界。
···
超级神魔大战时，
玄极天是魔界的主要进攻对象，
也是万界重要的保护对象，
毁天灭地的惨烈大战后，
两个超级大黑洞统称玄极天域，
太阳界和月亮界，
太阳主宰和月亮主宰成为传说，
有传说她们已经转生，
也有传说太阳主宰和月亮主宰本为一人分身，

虽然众说纷呈，
但现在的主宰以星辰运行为指引，
content_en:
At the corner of the boundary river,
There is a super huge black hole in the starry sky,
It was steaming inside, the flames were blazing, and the fire was soaring into the sky.
Normal gods who come here will be burned by Taixuan Tianyang Fire.
There won't be any scum left,
Every day the sun sets into this huge black hole,
Then another sun rises from the other side,
There are many suns here,
Moving among the celestial bodies is the mature sun,
Because the universe has existed for I don’t know how many years,
Therefore, many suns that have lost their energy have become useless stars, floating slowly rotating in this huge black hole.
On these huge waste stars, there are some living creatures.
They are the Xuanji Celestial Clan; the Sun God Clan!
The body is strong and the magic power is powerful.
They will choose the most powerful saint son and saint girl,
After reaching a certain amount of mana, they can control these suns and shine in all walks of life.
···
Next to the huge black hole,
There is also a super black hole,
It was extremely cold inside, with frost everywhere, a cold wind blowing, and an endless cold light.
Anyone below the god level who comes here will be frozen and broken into powder by Taixuan Yin Aurora.
When the extremely cold wind blows, there will be no powder left.
There are many moons in it,
Every day when the sun sets, the mature moon will rise into the sky.
Taking over from the sun and bringing the moonlight and mysterious yin energy to all walks of life,
Purify all the earth's evil spirits,
On those abandoned moons that can no longer shine in all worlds,
There are also living beings, the Moon God Clan,
They are also extremely powerful,
The mature moon is also controlled and controlled by the powerful saint son and saint girl, illuminating all walks of life.
···
During the battle between super gods and demons,
Xuanjitian is the main target of attack in the demon world.
It is also an important protection object in all realms.
After the tragic battle that destroyed the world,
The two super large black holes are collectively called the Xuanji Tianyu.
the world of the sun and the world of the moon,
The Lord of the Sun and the Lord of the Moon became legends,
There are legends that they have been reincarnated,
There are also legends that the sun ruler and the moon ruler were originally clones of the same person.
Although there are different opinions,
But now the Lord is guided by the movements of the stars,
